day.heading: Duty Day
day.title: Company Day Mode
day.notWired: Company day mode is not wired into this build (see WIRING-DAY.md).
day.startHint: Say "start duty day", or press the button. With day mode enabled and auto-start on, a day also begins at the first Preflight. Drop a rotations/*.json file for a planned day.
day.figuresNote: Block and duty figures are convenience tracking of what was flown — not a flight-time-limitations calculation.
